houses.pageTitle: Insidious (Haunted House)
houses.notes: REAL HOUSE, NOT A DUPLICATE. HHN 25 (Universal Studios Florida, 2015) had a house titled simply "Insidious", one of the event's nine houses, in Sprung Tent 2 (World Expo area), covering Insidious Chapters 1-3. It was announced in July 2015 together with Hollywood. Hollywood's maze that year was a separate attraction, "Insidious: Return to the Further" (Jurassic Park Queue). Fix the record to name "Insidious", parks [orlando], location "Sprung Tent 2" (the location field currently holds the name). Caveat: one Inside the Magic photo caption calls "Insidious: Return to The Further" "exclusively at Universal Orlando". That contradicts the wiki and Orlando Informer, which list the Orlando house as "Insidious"; treat it as a caption error. IMAGE: HHN 25 Orlando house title card for "Insidious" (500x278). Source file "Insidious.jpg" (500x278, image/jpeg); CDN serves image/webp by content negotiation. Fan-hosted copy of Universal artwork. CDN blocks the bare "Mozilla/5.0" UA (Cloudflare 403); verified 200 with a full browser UA.
